title: Daniel L. Johnson
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Married LeAnn Holman 1970; Idaho Falls Temple; six children
Bachelor's degree in accounting and economics from BYU
Various executive, Church and family farming positions throughout Latin America and the United States
Counselor to Stake President; Counselor to Mission President; Bishop; Area Seventy
President of Ecuador Guayaquil North Mission 1991-1994
